title: SDLC Reference Validation v1
description: Closed JSON response envelope for validating one direct SDLC reference string against the repository's schema-registered reference types.
$comment: The command first applies registered reference syntax checks and, for repository-local references, resolves the resource to return its global identity, repository root, absolute document path, and repository-relative document path. The schema registry is discovered from schemas marked with x-sdlc-reference-type: true.

schema.description: The canonical persisted response schema identifier.

ref.description: The direct reference string supplied to the validator.

valid.description: Whether at least one registered reference schema matches the supplied reference.

matches.description: Registered reference schemas whose syntax matches the supplied reference.

findings.description: Stable validation findings. The array is empty for a valid reference.

examples: No registered reference schema matched the supplied reference.
No registered reference schema matched the supplied reference.

globalResourceId.description: The globally qualified SDLC reference of the successfully resolved resource, when the local repository can resolve it.

repositoryRoot.description: The absolute root path of the repository in which the resource was resolved.

fullPath.description: The absolute path of the document that defines the resolved resource.

repositoryPath.description: The repository-relative path containing the successfully resolved resource, when the local repository can resolve it.

ReferenceMatch.description: A registered reference schema selected by the validator.

schemaId.description: The stable URI identifier of the matching reference schema.

path.description: The repository-relative path of the matching schema.

findings: No registered reference schema matched the supplied reference.
